text.tspan: Map and Set vs Object and Array
Pick by the KEY you have and the question you ask.
Arbitrary, or added at run time
ANY value can be a key:
Only an object serializes with JSON.stringify; a Map or Set turns into {}. Convert first: Object.fromEntries(map), [...set].
WeakMap and WeakSet hold their keys weakly, so an entry disappears when nothing else refers to the key. Use them to attach
data to an object without keeping it alive; they are not iterable and have no .size.
